Refine a RAPID-MA fit with guarded class-balanced pseudo-labels

Source: R/rapid_ma_semisup.R
rapid_ma_semisup.Rd

Refine a RAPID-MA fit with guarded class-balanced pseudo-labels

Usage

rapid_ma_semisup(
  fit,
  labels = NULL,
  train_mask = NULL,
  mode = c("transductive", "inductive"),
  initial_probabilities = NULL,
  validation_probabilities = NULL,
  control = rapid_ma_semisup_control()
)

Arguments

fit

A fitted `rapid_ma` object.

labels

Optional training-label vectors. In inductive mode, labels outside `train_mask` are discarded before any statistic is computed.

train_mask

Optional logical vectors identifying training rows.

mode

`"transductive"` or `"inductive"`.

initial_probabilities

Optional named-class probability matrices, one per domain. This permits a supervised downstream classifier to seed the sparse relation teacher without exposing any additional labels.

validation_probabilities

Optional out-of-fold probability matrices used only when `control$relation_validation = TRUE`. Values at observed label rows must be produced without training on those rows.

control

Settings from [rapid_ma_semisup_control()].

Value

The updated `rapid_ma` object with a `semisup` provenance record.
